preparation_noop.reason: superstage S5 says attaching only the Preparation pointer does not change plan semantics or increment Stage revision; the complete contract can receive its first PREPARED receipt.

predecessor_detail_preparation.reason: superstage S4 permits refinement of bounded predecessor-dependent filenames, helpers, and test setup when acceptance, scope, approach, dependencies, and contract semantics remain fixed; S5 increments Stage revision when preparation changes stage content.

scope_expansion_during_preparation.reason: superstage S4 requires REPLANNER structural replanning when evidence changes a scope boundary; it is not an in-place refinement.

source_revision_changed.reason: superstage S4 classifies an acceptance or source-ownership change as replanning, and S5 makes the prior receipt invalid when its source revision no longer matches current evidence.

unrelated_head_advance.reason: superstage S3/S5 require a focused relevance check rather than raw HEAD equality; with no relevant change, record a refreshed validation receipt tied to the new baseline without silently editing old evidence.

relevant_contract_advance.reason: superstage S4 requires replanning for changed shared-contract behavior or semantic revision, and S5 requires receipt contract revisions to match current evidence.

missing_preparation_receipt.reason: superstage S3 says an upfront leaf without a valid PREPARED receipt is not executable and returns needs-refinement/BLOCKED to the calling entry point rather than falling through to legacy selection.

partially_executed_stage.reason: superstage S3 classifies verified execution evidence as integration pending and directs recovery through execution/CI; it says never to overwrite an already-running stage's task history with in-place preparation.
